title: Martin Eden
author: Jack London
summary: Martin Eden, a poor young sailor, falls for a middle-class woman and sets out to educate himself and become a writer. As success arrives, it brings him far less than he had imagined.
readIf: you like semi-autobiographical novels about ambition, class and self-education.
skipIf: you need an uplifting ending or are sensitive to depictions of despair.
